capabilities: Import Douyin share links or pasted share text via a modal, ribbon icon, or clipboard command
Download no-watermark videos and all carousel images into an attachments folder
Transcribe video captions to Simplified Chinese with a local Whisper model
Generate structured notes with frontmatter, hashtag callout, embedded media, and caption sections
Check connection to the local Python backend from settings and the command palette
disambiguation: Not a general web clipper; it only imports Douyin share links and pasted share text.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.4.0+; mobile unsupported). Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a disclaimer restricting use to personal learning and research; no Douyin cookie or paid API is needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Douyin share links into notes with no-watermark media, caption text, and metadata saved locally.

relations.evidence: This plugin depends on the local Python service obsidian-content-capture-backend

summary: Imports Douyin share links into Obsidian as structured notes with downloaded videos, carousel images, captions, and optional local Whisper transcription.
